A beautifully minimal space for focused writing

Pencake helps you focus on your words—whether you’re writing a journal, a story, or something just for yourself. Since 2018, more than 2.3 million writers have chosen Pencake as their space to write in peace. Its clean, distraction-free interface helps you focus entirely on your words. No clutter, no noise—just you and your story. With elegant typography and smooth spacing, writing on Pencake feels as natural and beautiful as writing in a real book. Whether you're an aspiring writer or just someone who loves writing in peace, Pencake offers a simple yet inspiring place to put your thoughts into words.
🌿 Minimalist, yet powerful
Clean and aesthetically refined interface
Designed to enhance focus and creativity
Beautiful fonts and themes that suit your mood
🖋️ Writing made effortless
Start writing instantly with an intuitive experience
Enjoy smooth performance even with long-form writing
Stay organized with “Stories” that group related entries
☁️ Write anywhere, anytime
Sync your work seamlessly across all your devices
Available on iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS
Continue writing wherever inspiration strikes
🔒 Safe and secure writing
Auto-save, version history, and trash recovery
Full ownership of all your data – your content always remains yours
Face ID / Touch ID protection
📖 Built for real writers
Supports Markdown for flexible formatting
Word and character count, image insertion, and preview mode
Ideal for all kinds of writing—journaling, blogging, novel writing, and fanfiction
